title: Stop these Indian podcasts...
description:
Podcasts were supposed to be a space for honest, intelligent conversations—but in India, they’re slowly turning into PR machines. From promoting superstition in the name of spirituality to doing paid episodes that whitewash corrupt politicians and shady businessmen, many podcasters have sold out.

Instead of asking tough questions, they offer soft landings—for money, fame, or access. What started as a platform for free thought has become a marketplace of manipulation.

In this video, we expose how Indian podcasts are losing credibility—and how the audience is being played in the name of “deep conversation.”
